---
title: "hdWGCNA of human putamen SPNs across Braak stages (Figure 6G-J)"
output: html_document
---

<!--
Purpose : co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA) of human SPN subclusters,
          non-PD (Braak 0) vs Braak 4 vs Braak 6.
Input   : annotated human SPN Seurat object
          (rna.combined_res1_sub_annotated_allen_noduplicates.rds).
Outputs (written to out_dir):
  hdWGCNA_modules_by_color.xlsx           module gene assignment and kME
  Module_FeaturePlots.pdf                 Fig 6G  module eigengene UMAPs
  DME_Braak_vs_nonPD.csv,
  builtin_comparison_modules_per_condition_avglogfc_ordered.pdf
                                          Fig 6H  DMEs (FindDMEs, Wilcoxon, Bonferroni)
  Module_Load_Braak.csv,
  Human_Module_Load_Braak.pdf             Fig 6I  module load (sum of |delta ME| vs non-PD over SPN subclusters)
  <module>_ME_violin_wilcox.pdf           Fig 6J  ME violins (Wilcoxon vs non-PD)
-->

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(WGCNA)
library(hdWGCNA)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(writexl)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

# Paths (edit)
data_dir <- "data"                         # folder containing the input Seurat object
out_dir  <- "results/hdWGCNA_SPN_human"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

set.seed(12345)
```

```{r load-and-subset}
# Load the annotated SPN object and keep SPN subclusters only
rna.combined_sub <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "rna.combined_res1_sub_annotated_allen_noduplicates.rds"))
rna.combined_sub <- subset(x = rna.combined_sub, idents = setdiff(unique(Idents(rna.combined_sub)), c("Ctx IT", "INs", "Splatter")))

# Remove the cells in the UMAP region excluded from the analysis
umap_data <- Embeddings(rna.combined_sub, reduction = "umap_after_harmony_4")
cells_to_keep <- !(umap_data[, 1] >= 2 & umap_data[, 1] <= 9 &
                   umap_data[, 2] >= 0 & umap_data[, 2] <= 6)
rna.combined_sub <- subset(rna.combined_sub, cells = colnames(rna.combined_sub)[cells_to_keep])
rna.combined_sub$clusters <- Idents(rna.combined_sub)

# Keep Braak 0 (non-PD), 4 and 6
rna.combined_sub <- subset(rna.combined_sub, subset = Braak != 3)
rna.combined_sub <- subset(rna.combined_sub, subset = Braak != 5)
```

```{r network}
# Gene selection: genes expressed in >= 5% of cells
rna.combined <- SetupForWGCNA(
  rna.combined_sub,
  gene_select = "fraction",
  fraction = 0.05,
  wgcna_name = "wgcna_1"
)
rm(rna.combined_sub)

# Metacells per SPN subcluster and Braak stage
rna.combined <- MetacellsByGroups(
  seurat_obj = rna.combined,
  group.by = c("clusters", "Braak"),
  reduction = 'umap_after_harmony_4',
  k = 20,
  max_shared = 10,
  ident.group = 'Braak'
)
rna.combined <- NormalizeMetacells(rna.combined)

DefaultAssay(rna.combined) <- "RNA"
rna.combined <- NormalizeData(
  object = rna.combined,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize"
)

# Expression matrix for network construction (all Braak groups)
rna.combined$Braak <- as.character(rna.combined$Braak)
valid_groups <- rna.combined$Braak
rna.combined <- SetDatExpr(
  rna.combined,
  group_name = valid_groups,
  group.by = "Braak",
  assay = "SCT",
  layer = "data"
)

# Soft-power selection (signed network)
rna.combined <- TestSoftPowers(
  rna.combined,
  networkType = 'signed'
)

# Co-expression network (soft power 9); TOM is written to disk
rna.combined <- ConstructNetwork(
  rna.combined, soft_power = 9,
  tom_name = "SPNs_braak", overwrite_tom = TRUE
)
```

```{r eigengenes}
# Module eigengenes (MEs) in the full single-cell dataset
rna.combined <- ScaleData(rna.combined, features = VariableFeatures(rna.combined))
rna.combined <- ModuleEigengenes(rna.combined)

# Eigengene-based connectivity (kME) and module renaming (Module_1 ... Module_9)
rna.combined <- ModuleConnectivity(rna.combined)
rna.combined <- ResetModuleNames(rna.combined, new_name = "Module_")

# Module assignment table (genes, module, colour, kME)
modules <- GetModules(rna.combined) %>% subset(module != 'grey')
write_xlsx(modules, path = file.path(out_dir, "hdWGCNA_modules_by_color.xlsx"))

# MEs per nucleus, with Braak stage
hMEs <- GetMEs(rna.combined)
hMEs$Braak <- rna.combined$Braak

braak_colors <- c("0" = "gray", "4" = "#a34246ff", "6" = "#330000")
```

```{r fig6G-feature-plots}
# Fig 6G: module eigengene UMAPs
p_list <- ModuleFeaturePlot(
  rna.combined, reduction = "umap_after_harmony_4",
  features = 'hMEs', order = TRUE
)
for (i in seq_along(p_list)) {
  p_list[[i]] <- p_list[[i]] +
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "grey", mid = "#81a6b8", high = "#003366", na.value = "grey80") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"))
}
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Module_FeaturePlots.pdf"),
       wrap_plots(p_list, ncol = 3), width = 12, height = 12)
```

```{r fig6H-DMEs}
# Fig 6H: differential module eigengenes, each Braak stage vs non-PD (Braak 0).
# FindDMEs sets negative MEs to zero and runs a Wilcoxon test (Bonferroni-adjusted p).
control_barcodes <- rownames(subset(rna.combined@meta.data, Braak == "0"))

dme_list <- list()
for (group in c("4", "6")) {
  experimental_barcodes <- rownames(subset(rna.combined@meta.data, Braak == group))
  # barcodes1 = Braak stage, barcodes2 = non-PD; positive logFC = higher in PD
  res <- FindDMEs(
    rna.combined,
    barcodes1 = experimental_barcodes,
    barcodes2 = control_barcodes,
    test.use = "wilcox",
    harmonized = TRUE,
    wgcna_name = "wgcna_1"
  )
  res$Comparison <- paste0(group, "_vs_0")
  res$Module <- rownames(res)
  dme_list[[group]] <- res
}
all_dme_results <- do.call(rbind, dme_list)
write.csv(all_dme_results, file.path(out_dir, "DME_Braak_vs_nonPD.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Dot plot: colour = avg log2FC, size = -log10(adjusted p), capped at 20
plot_data <- all_dme_results %>%
  mutate(
    log_p = pmin(-log10(p_val_adj), 20),
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("6_vs_0", "4_vs_0"))
  )

p_dme <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Comparison, y = reorder(Module, avg_log2FC), color = avg_log2FC)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = log_p)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#31869bff", mid = "gray", high = "#963634ff",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), oob = scales::squish,
    name = "avg Log2FC"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "-log10 adj. P") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Braak stage vs non-PD", y = "Module") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "builtin_comparison_modules_per_condition_avglogfc_ordered.pdf"), width = 6, height = 8)
print(p_dme)
dev.off()
```

```{r fig6I-module-load}
# Fig 6I: mean ME per module x SPN subcluster x Braak stage; change vs non-PD;
# module load = sum over subclusters of |delta|
mean_ME <- hMEs %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Braak) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cell_id, names_to = "Module", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(Module != "grey") %>%
  left_join(rna.combined@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(clusters, Braak) %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id"),
            by = "cell_id") %>%
  group_by(Module, clusters, Braak) %>%
  summarise(mean_ME = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Braak, values_from = mean_ME, names_prefix = "B") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("B"), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

module_load <- mean_ME %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(
    `Braak 4 vs non-PD` = sum(abs(B4 - B0), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Braak 6 vs non-PD` = sum(abs(B6 - B0), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Module, names_to = "Comparison", values_to = "Module_Load")
write.csv(module_load, file.path(out_dir, "Module_Load_Braak.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_load <- ggplot(module_load, aes(x = reorder(Module, -Module_Load), y = Module_Load, fill = Comparison)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Braak 4 vs non-PD" = "#d8b0b2ff", "Braak 6 vs non-PD" = "#5e2f31")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Modules", y = "Cumulative |Delta|")
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Human_Module_Load_Braak.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
print(p_load)
dev.off()
```

```{r fig6J-violins}
# Fig 6J: ME violins for modules that differ across Braak stages
# (one-way ANOVA per module, FDR < 0.05); two-sided Wilcoxon vs non-PD (ggpubr, unadjusted)
hMEs_long <- hMEs %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Braak, names_to = "Module", values_to = "Eigengene") %>%
  filter(Module != "grey")

sig_modules <- hMEs_long %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(p_value = summary(aov(Eigengene ~ Braak))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]) %>%
  mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  filter(adj_p < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Module)

for (mod in sig_modules) {
  p_vln <- hMEs_long %>%
    filter(Module == mod) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Braak, y = Eigengene, fill = Braak)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.8, color = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 5, color = "black") +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("0", "4"), c("0", "6")), method = "wilcox.test") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = braak_colors) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = mod, y = "Eigengene", x = "Braak stage")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(mod, "_ME_violin_wilcox.pdf")), p_vln, width = 5, height = 5)
}
```

```{r save}
saveRDS(rna.combined, file = file.path(out_dir, "rna_combined_spn_subtypes_hdwgcna_Braak.rds"))
sessionInfo()
```
